candidates.title: [RFC]: [Spec decode] KV-cache pool collapse when a draft model introduces a new cache spec type (hybrid GDN + DFlash): diagnosis, mitigation dead-ends, and a working dedicated-draft-pool POC
candidates.snippet: ### Motivation.  The unified hybrid KV-cache pool assumes that all attention layers can be grouped by their KV-cache spec type and that **every request draws blocks from every group**. This assumption breaks when a speculative-decoding draft model registers attention layers whose spec type no target layer has: the draft's spec type fragments grouping, inflates per-request block demand, and the scheduler's usable KV pool collapses — even though the draft itself needs very little memory. candidates.snippet: ### Motivation.  **TL;DR**  - On ROCm, AITER's shuffled KV pages give the fastest decode at high batch.
